RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Crossfire
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A damaging basic hit leaves an opening. A teammate's basic hit on that enemy deals 4 extra fixed base damage. 6-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Flanking Strike
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A damaging basic hit leaves an opening. A teammate's basic hit deals 6 extra fixed base damage if the two colonists form an angle of at least 90 degrees around the enemy. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Rolling Pressure
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Damaging an enemy with an ability leaves an opening. A teammate's basic hit reduces your longest eligible learned personal combat cooldown by 1 second, without making it immediately ready. Preserves the opening if none is cooling down. Shared abilities, utility skills and fixed recovery timers are unaffected. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Covering Fire
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Taking actual damage from an enemy's basic attack while remaining standing marks the attacker. A teammate's basic hit on that enemy grants you 6 shield for 6 seconds. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Field Relief
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Actually healing at least 2 injury points on a teammate with this mod's healing effects prepares a relay. That teammate's damaging basic hit on an enemy grants both of you 4 shield for 4 seconds. Self-healing and overhealing do not count. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shared Burden
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A damaging basic hit leaves an opening. If that enemy's basic attack actually damages another standing teammate, the teammate gains 6 shield and you gain 3 shield, both for 6 seconds. Shields appear after the hit and cannot absorb its damage. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.
